neighbours.label: a field-of-study word naming a research area or institutional discipline (medical imaging, mathematical biology), as opposed to a person's expertise (+ pole)
fire: The department covers genomics, cell biology and medical imaging.
She founded a research group in mathematical ecology at the university.
The conference on chemical education meets in Vienna.
He teaches courses in civil engineering and design.
The journal publishes work on architectural history.
Patients can order medical grade compression socks.
The institute focuses on mathematical optimization and statistics.
Funding goes to renewable energy and engineering research.
quiet: You don't need to be a mathematical genius to enjoy the book.
For those rusty on their biology, cells divide by mitosis.
No legal background is needed for this course.
Even computer nerds sometimes forget their passwords.
The department has a large staff and a new building.
She founded a research group at the university in 2005.
Patients can order compression socks online.
Funding goes to new projects at the lab.

notes: The + pole fires on the same kind of words used as a person's skill ('a mathematical wunderkind', 'rusty on your ecology', 'no legal background'); four near misses test that side.
